text: The ___ thesis holds that an agent believes a proposition p (in the binary, full-belief sense) if and only if their credence in p exceeds some threshold t.
explanation: The Lockean thesis links credence to binary belief: believe p iff cr(p) > t for some threshold t < 1. It runs into the lottery and preface paradoxes, which show that threshold belief is not closed under conjunction -- one may rationally believe of each lottery ticket that it loses (each credence above threshold) yet not believe the conjunction that every ticket loses.
